title: How Alexandr Wang launched Muse: agents for non-coders, trust over raw capability
summary: Wang explains why Muse took off: it brought the agent experience engineers had to everyone else, pitched as saving money and time. He stresses polish, hard security work before launch, and that consumer trust will matter more than raw model intelligence.

principles.text: Find the gap: bring what power users already enjoy to everyone else
principles.quote: most people in the world they don't know how to code. They probably never even want to code. Um but they still want to feel the experience of agents
